description: Registration configuration (walk-in identifier format, default facility).

fields.label: Walk-in Identifier Format
fields.description: Placeholders: {facility_code}, {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, and one run of # for the sequence, e.g. {#####}. The counter restarts for every distinct prefix. Format pending OI-13.

fields.label: Default Registration Facility
fields.description: Used when neither the patient nor the user's default sets a facility.

fields.label: Similarity Candidate Limit
fields.description: How many records matching one name sound are scored, newest first. Exact matches on both names, or on one name with the same date of birth and sex, are always scored.

fields.label: Seed Version
fields.description: Internal: version of the one-off seed updates applied by install.

name: EMR Registration Settings
